source: DepMap CRISPRGeneEffect.csv (Chronos gene effect, public release)
preprocessing: strip Entrez ids from column labels; transpose to genes x cell lines; collapse duplicate symbols by nanmean; per-gene mean impute; drop zero-variance and non-finite genes; per-gene centre; TruncatedSVD
leakage: unsupervised TruncatedSVD on the external DepMap matrix only; no benchmark target, split index or perturbation label enters the fit
gene_names: depmap_coess_gene_names.json, row order for both tables
